title: Gate summaries count Chough's records and files merged from main (#190)
symptom: a gate summary's What changed line counts every Chough record, knowledge note and file merged from main since the change's base commit
trigger: Make a one-line product edit, record evidence and knowledge, merge main into the branch, then chough gate list
expected: the summary counts from the merge base with the default branch and leaves out .chough/, the knowledge directory and SpecSync bookkeeping: one file, named
actual: 509 files, with Chough's evidence entries among the top five
steps: one product edit; 300 records under .chough/ and knowledge/; 200 files on main merged in
impact: The human deciding a gate cannot see what the change touched (GitHub #190)
source: GitHub issue #190; red on 0.5.0 at leif/0.6.0-190-red 603456f3
